query: What is the history of Cendara University?

supporting_facts.text: Cendara University was established in the spring of 1956 by Dr. Franklin M. Avery as Cendara College with 87 students and 12 faculty members. The institution was initially housed in a restored municipal building on East Willow Avenue.

Each loan has specific conditions, such as need-based requirements, interest rates, and credit checks, with loan counseling required for new borrowers.

query: What awards did Cendara University receive for sustainability and inclusion in 2023?

supporting_facts.text: Cendara University received the Innovative Campus Sustainability Program Award from the Green Futures Alliance for the “Solar Steps” energy overhaul, and the Excellence in Diversity and Inclusion (Gold Level) from the National Association for Inclusive Education for the “Bridge Horizons” initiative.

query: Who received the Chancellor’s Award for Excellence in Teaching in 2024?

supporting_facts.text: Dr. Simone L. Marquez received the Chancellor’s Award for Excellence in Teaching in 2024 for her distinguished teaching and innovative curriculum development in applied mathematics.

query: When was the Distinguished Alumni Achievement Award presented to Dr. Priyanka Halson?

supporting_facts.text: The Distinguished Alumni Achievement Award was presented to Dr. Priyanka Halson on March 15, 2024.

query: Why was Dr. Priyanka Halson recognized with the Distinguished Alumni Achievement Award?

supporting_facts.text: Dr. Priyanka Halson was recognized with the Distinguished Alumni Achievement Award for pioneering advancements in heart disease diagnostics and her commitment to global health advocacy, exemplifying Cendara values.

query: How does the award received by the Cendara Debate Society differ from the award won by Elena DiLuca?

supporting_facts.text: The Cendara Debate Society won the Intercollegiate Ethics Bowl, triumphing over nine regional universities in March 2024. Elena DiLuca won First Place at the National Short Film Festival for her original screenplay in November 2023.

query: What courses are offered in the first year of the B.N.S. program at Cendara University?

supporting_facts.text: The first-year courses in the B.N.S. program include: NURS 101: Foundations of Professional Nursing, NURS 111: Human Anatomy & Physiology I, NURS 112: Human Anatomy & Physiology II, NURS 120: Health Assessment, and NURS 130: Introduction to Clinical Practice.

query: How does NURS 221 differ from NURS 220 in the Nursing program?

supporting_facts.text: NURS 220: Medical-Surgical Nursing I focuses on common medical and surgical health problems with emphasis on assessment and intervention. NURS 221: Medical-Surgical Nursing II builds on NURS 220 by addressing complex health conditions and advanced intervention techniques.

query: What is the primary focus of the NURS 340: Community Health Nursing course?

supporting_facts.text: NURS 340: Community Health Nursing prepares students to employ health promotion and disease prevention strategies, conduct assessments, and plan interventions in community settings.

query: What are the prerequisites for the NURS 420: Advanced Clinical Practicum?

supporting_facts.text: The prerequisites for NURS 420 include NURS 221 and the completion of all previous clinical courses.

query: Why is the NURS 440: Capstone Seminar vital for nursing students?

supporting_facts.text: The NURS 440: Capstone Seminar integrates learning from all previous coursework and clinical experiences, preparing students for the national licensure exam (NCLEX-RN) and transition to professional practice.
